race.comment: SOHO SUSHI (6) has the most reliable recent profile, having run second at Canberra in her past two starts and gone under by just over half a length most recently when prominent in betting. Her 1000m record is sound and the 2kg claim helps. On top. CAN DO IT (1) is the proven course-and-distance runner, with three wins and four placings from 13 attempts at this track and distance, and his last-start fourth had merit after he was held up late. KILTIKI (5) comes through a Class 1 placing at Dubbo and is fitter third-up, though he still has to prove he can sharpen enough at 1000m. JUST JOAN (8) brings a similar Dubbo line, having finished second there at generous odds, and her previous win at this track and distance keeps her firmly in the place mix. FRENCH HARP (11) can show something second-up.
